tool_args.rationale: The equal-input observation constrains the equilibrium component, while opposing step changes and varied horizons constrain contrast gain and relaxation. The available rows make the three-parameter recalled mechanism identifiable without buying another probe. Fit parameters numerically to the paid rows.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows span equal and opposing input steps across several horizons, enough to estimate the three parameters in the recalled contrast law; the opposing-step signature supports this family.
A state-only mean-reverting model cannot naturally account for the sign reversal between equal-state rows with opposing input steps.
It omits the nonzero equal-input response visible in the fifth row, whereas the recalled normalized contrast law includes an equilibrium input term.
